items.title: Equity Residential, AvalonBay announce name of combined firm: Vivmark Residential
items.summary: The name reflects “a company determined to set a new standard for the experience of home,” said Benjamin Schall, AvalonBay CEO and incoming CEO of Vivmark Residential.

items.title: Camden Property Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates, Occupancy Improves
items.summary: CPT tops Q2 core FFO estimates as occupancy remains firm and leasing trends improve, while acquisitions and updated guidance shape its outlook.

items.title: Mid-America Apartment Q2 FFO Misses Estimates as Same-Store NOI Falls
items.summary: MAA lags Q2 FFO estimates as same-store NOI declines, but improving lease trends and a steady development pipeline point to stabilizing operations.

items.title: INVH Q2 FFO Beats Estimates on NOI Growth, Revenues Top, '26 View Up
items.summary: Invitation Homes outpaces Q2 FFO estimates as higher lease rates, same-store NOI growth and the ResiBuilt acquisition drive revenues, prompting a higher 2026 outlook.

items.title: ESS Q2 FFO Beats Estimates on Higher Property NOI, '26 View Raised
items.summary: ESS tops Q2 FFO estimates as same-property NOI and revenues rise, Northern California outperforms, and its 2026 core FFO outlook is raised.

items.title: UDR Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Leasing Strength, '26 View Up
items.summary: UDR outpaces Q2 FFO estimates, delivers stronger leasing and same-store growth, and raises its 2026 FFO outlook as occupancy and resident retention remain strong.

items.title: AvalonBay, Equity Residential beat FFO estimates in Q2
items.summary: The “merger of equals” partners raised guidance, following signs of strength in San Francisco and New York City.

items.title: AvalonBay Q2 FFO Beats Estimates on Same-Store Gains, '26 Views Raised
items.summary: AVB tops Q2 core FFO estimates, raises its same-store outlook and advances development plans as it moves closer to its proposed merger.
